whitby_skipper.text: The Saucy Kittiwake is a fair boat and a fussy one. Feed her bait, mind the weather and she will pay her way.
Rates come out of the takings. The council writes a lovely letter about it.

whitby_hand.text: Thirty years on that quay and I still check the sky twice. A storm costs you the day's catch, never the boat.
Mackerel in summer, cod and haddock in winter. Seaweed and nettles make decent bait if you are not fussy about the smell.

guild_anglers.text: Sit still, say little, and never admit the size of the one that got away.
